sections.heading: Postmortem Identification, Trace DNA, Entomology, Taphonomy & Pattern Evidence

episodes.label: The Paint That Took the Cloth — Hit-and-Run Friction-Fused Polyester Masking Automotive FTIR Spectra, Cross-Sectional Layering & Sub-Visible Pigments
episodes.notes: Forensic trace paint chemistry in high-speed pedestrian impacts: Hu et al.'s hit-and-run reconstruction showing why friction-melted polyester coat fibers masked red trailer paint on surface FTIR until cross-sectional separation, Palenik's NIJ sub-visible automotive pigment characterization, and forensic paint comparison standards.

episodes.label: The Dandelion in the Sample — Gastric Chloroplast trnL Barcoding, GC-MS Phytosterols, Autopsy Diet Metabarcoding & Gastric Emptying MRI
episodes.notes: Forensic botany and gastric-content timing boundaries: direct chloroplast DNA sequencing and GC-MS identification of ingested Taraxacum in autopsy stomach contents, Taberlet et al.'s (2007) short plastid trnL barcodes for degraded tissue, Schneider et al.'s (2021) autopsy gastric metabarcoding pilot, and Farivar et al.'s (2026) MRI gastric-emptying kinetics.

episodes.label: The Implant That Led to Four Hospitals — Brno Orthopedic Serial-Number Tracing Across 117 Records, Radiographic Comparison & ASB Standard 148
episodes.notes: Forensic personal identification via implanted medical devices: Hirt et al.'s (2018) Brno hip-prosthesis batch trace across four hospitals and 117 surgical records, Blessing & Lin's regional medical-examiner series on unique device serial numbers, skeletal radiographic matching, and ANSI/ASB Standard 148 (2024).

episodes.label: The Print That Passed the Check — Mayfield Latent Print Misidentification, Ulery Black-Box Accuracy & Repeatability & Busey Examiner Eye-Tracking
episodes.notes: Forensic latent print examination from the DOJ OIG Mayfield misidentification review (2011) through Ulery et al.'s black-box accuracy (PNAS 2011) and intra-/inter-examiner repeatability/reproducibility studies (PLOS ONE 2012) and Busey et al.'s (2021) eye-tracking analysis of comparison gaze and missed identifications.

episodes.label: The Search for a Name — Forensic Identification, Missing Persons & Postmortem Evidence Chains
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The Search for a Name): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: The DNA That Stayed Behind — Trace Biological Transfer, Mixture Interpretation & Forensic Genetics
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The DNA That Stayed Behind): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: When the Insects Arrived — Forensic Entomology, Blowfly Succession & Postmortem Interval Clocks
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (When the Insects Arrived): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: The Ground Had a Second Story — Clandestine Burials, Taphonomy & Soil Forensics
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The Ground Had a Second Story): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: What a Mark Can Name — Toolmark Impression Physics, Breech-Face Striations & Pattern Evidence Limits
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (What a Mark Can Name): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: The Autopsy in the Archive — Cold-Case Re-Examinations, Archival Histology & Postmortem Reinterpretation
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The Autopsy in the Archive): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: When the Air Stops Being Safe — Carbon Monoxide Co-Toxicity, Carboxyhemoglobin & Fire Neuropathology
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The Forensics of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: The Drug Behind the Result — Lisdexamfetamine Prodrugs, Chiral d/l-Amphetamine LC-MS/MS & Matrix Stability
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Evidence Ledger & Longform Analysis (The Drug Behind the Result): specimen-bound diagnostic mechanics, assay boundaries, and real clinical/forensic case studies.

episodes.label: The Glass That Traveled — Forensic Glass Refractive Index, Elemental Trace Comparison, Transfer & Persistence
episodes.notes: Forensic trace-evidence investigation into broken glass fragments: refractive index oil-immersion annealing, LA-ICP-MS elemental discrimination, backward fragmentation plume physics, and clothing persistence decay.

episodes.label: When Air Appears on the Scan — Postmortem CT Gas Distribution, Putrefactive Hepatic Portal Gas vs. Vital Air Embolism
episodes.notes: Forensic radiology and autopsy investigation of gas on postmortem CT (PMCT): distinguishing putrefactive gas formation, cardiopulmonary resuscitation barotrauma, and true vital venous or arterial gas embolism.

episodes.label: When the Current Left No Mark — Low-Voltage & Wet-Contact Electrocution, Absent Joule Burns, Ventricular Fibrillation & Scene Circuit Reconstruction
episodes.notes: Forensic pathology and electrical engineering investigation of fatal electrocution without cutaneous Joule burns: broad wet skin contact area, current density thresholds for ventricular fibrillation, histological nuclear streaming and metallization, and scene ground-fault testing.

episodes.label: The Boots in the Snow — Hypothermia Pathophysiology, Paradoxical Undressing, Terminal Burrowing & Wischnewsky Gastric Spots
episodes.notes: Forensic investigation of fatal environmental hypothermia: why cold victims shed footwear and clothing (paradoxical undressing) and crawl into confined spaces (terminal burrowing), and how autopsy combines Wischnewsky spots with vitreous glucose and β-hydroxybutyrate.

episodes.label: What the Bottle Could Not Tell — Postmortem Toxicology Redistribution, Pill-Bottle Scene Priors vs. Femoral Blood Quantification & Tolerance Boundaries
episodes.notes: Forensic toxicology investigation of why pill bottles and scene containers cannot establish cause of death alone: postmortem central-to-peripheral redistribution, femoral vs. cardiac blood sampling, quantitative LC-MS/MS confirmation, and acquired opioid/sedative tolerance.

episodes.label: The Flies That Arrived Late — Forensic Entomology Colonization Delay, Accumulated Degree-Hours (ADH), Indoor Access Barriers & Minimum Postmortem Interval
episodes.notes: Forensic entomology investigation of why blowfly larval age defines minimum colonization time (mPMI) rather than time of death: nocturnal oviposition limits, sealed indoor enclosures, wrapping barriers, weather station microclimate corrections, and myiasis/toxicological larval growth shifts.

episodes.label: The Water in the Bone — Forensic Drowning Diagnosis, Femoral Marrow Diatom Extraction, Acid-Digestion Contamination Controls & Postmortem Submersion
episodes.notes: Forensic pathology of bodies recovered from water: why lung weight and froth disappear with decomposition, closed femoral bone-marrow diatom biomineral extraction, species-level ecological matching against reference water samples, and strict laboratory reagent blank controls.

episodes.label: What the Sequence Cannot Say Alone — Germline Exomes & Genomes (H026), Karyotypes vs. Microarrays & Mosaicism (H027) & Veterinary Bone Marrow Architecture (V020)
episodes.notes: One Medicine genomic, cytogenetic, and hematopoietic pathology synthesis (H026, H027, V020): DeRoin (2022) 350-patient fibroblast vs. blood germline testing, Manrai (2016) ancestry reference bias, Project Baby Bear (184 NICU infants), Bagnall (2016) 490 sudden cardiac deaths, Wapner (2012) 4,406 prenatal microarrays, Reddy (2012) 532 stillbirths, Halgren (2018) 17-year balanced rearrangements, Pallister-Killian buccal vs. blood mosaicism, feline vs. canine marrow iron stores, 2026 two-site canine marrow concordance, canine PIMA rubriphagocytosis (61/66), reversible feline B12 pancytopenia, and the 2021 UK 580-cat pancytopenia outbreak.

episodes.label: What the Surface Sample Missed — Cervical Cytology & Self-Collected HPV Trials (H028), Canine & Feline Tissue Biopsy Margins (V019) & Deep vs. Surface Skin Scrapings (V032)
episodes.notes: One Medicine epithelial, mucosal, and surgical pathology deep dive (H028, V019, V032): ASCCP unsatisfactory vs. absent-TZ rules, 2025 SELF-CERV vaginal HPV trial (n=599), HPV FOCAL (n=19,009), European pooled RCTs (n=176,464), English HPV vaccine registry (13.7M person-years), gastric-type adenocarcinoma missed by cone biopsy, Kemp (2015) 70-dog liver biopsy concordance (60%-69%), Marsilio (2019) 12/20 healthy cats called small-cell lymphoma on IHC/PARR, 2026 32-dog STS biopsy undergrading, 94-dog STS 3-year margin recurrence (41.2%/22.5%/7.1%), Barillas (2019) demodicosis hair-pluck vs. deep-scrape monitoring, Díaz (2023) post-cure Malassezia qPCR persistence, and Bizikova (2019) 35-cat pemphigus foliaceus relapses (24/31).

episodes.label: The Blood Type That Was Missing — Canine Dal Red-Cell Antigen Discovery, Day-40 Post-Transfusion Alloimmunization, Goulet Breed Prevalence & Severe Anemia Typing-Card Limits
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain veterinary transfusion investigation: how a Dalmatian compatible with two Borzoi donors at day 0 agglutinated all 55 non-Dalmatian donors by day 40, revealing the autosomal-dominant Dal erythrocyte antigen, Goulet et al. (2017) breed prevalence, and Veran/Blais (2023) cage-side typing card agglutination limits in severely anemic dogs.

episodes.label: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube — Reverse Pseudohyperkalemia in Leukocytosis, Pneumatic Tube Shear vs. Hand-Carried Whole Blood, Cold-Induced ABCB6 Leak & ECG Sensitivity Traps
episodes.notes: Dissecting in-vitro potassium artifacts before the analyzer: Mansoor et al. (2015) reverse pseudohyperkalemia (9.5 mmol/L across three analyzers vs. 3.7 mmol/L on hand-carried whole blood due to pneumatic-tube mechanical lysis of fragile leukemic white cells in heparinized plasma), Xiong et al. (2022) familial cold-induced ABCB6 red-cell potassium leak, and Raffee et al. (2022) why a normal ECG cannot rule out true hyperkalemia.

episodes.label: The Pressure Behind the Reading — Human Bilateral Topiramate Angle-Closure Glaucoma (H052), Feline Post-Traumatic Hypotony & Lens Rupture (V033), Applanation vs. Rebound Tonometry & Ocular Ultrasound
episodes.notes: One Medicine ophthalmic tonometry and structural imaging comparison (H052 & V033): Al-Naqeeb et al. (2021) bilateral topiramate ciliochoroidal effusion with 55/58 mmHg angle closure resolved by cycloplegia and drug cessation rather than iridotomy, Ricci et al. (2024) feline rebound vs. applanation tonometry bias across IOP ranges, and Klever et al. (2025) ocular ultrasound of feline scleral and lens rupture masked by hyphema.

episodes.label: The Piece the Camera Couldn't See — Normal-Appearing Mucosa in Eosinophilic Esophagitis (169 Eos/HPF, H047), Canine Pseudotumoral Bacterial Gastritis (V036) & Multilevel GI Biopsy Architecture
episodes.notes: One Medicine gastrointestinal endoscopy and mucosal biopsy investigation (H047 & V036): why optically normal human esophageal mucosa can conceal severe eosinophilic esophagitis (169 eosinophils/HPF) unless multilevel biopsies are taken, why canine gastric masses mimicking neoplasia on endoscopy require submucosal histology and special stains, and patchy sampling error.

episodes.label: The Number After the Sting — Postmortem Tryptase Site Divergence (8,955 Antemortem vs. <5,000 Central vs. 319 Peripheral ng/mL), Systemic Mastocytosis Baselines & Anaphylaxis Thresholds
episodes.notes: Forensic pathology and clinical toxicology of fatal insect-sting anaphylaxis: dramatic divergence between antemortem catheter blood (8,955 ng/mL), postmortem central blood (<5,000 ng/mL), and postmortem peripheral femoral blood (319 ng/mL), systemic mastocytosis baseline tryptase elevation, and why isolated postmortem cutoffs fail without anatomic sampling discipline.

episodes.label: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of tissue histopathology (H029), multiparameter flow cytometry (H030), and veterinary helical CT (V016): cold ischemia, formalin kinetics, Elmore's 240x115 breast biopsy concordance and STR floater checks; MBL, TRBC1, COG/EuroFlow MRD, and anti-CD19 lineage switch; and canine lung staging (41/459 nodules on X-ray), breath-hold recruitment, 66-dog portosystemic shunt CTA, and caval tumor-thrombus mapping.

episodes.label: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of human musculoskeletal radiography (H031), veterinary echocardiography (V015), and veterinary neuro-MRI (V017): Ottawa rules, occult scaphoid/hip cohorts, 10-14 day osteomyelitis lag, and 21-view forensic surveys; allometric cardiac scaling (BW^0.294), EPIC (n=360), feline Transient Myocardial Thickening (n=21), and Doppler 4V^2 math; and Ito's 71-dog myelomalacia prognostic rule, post-ictal piriform mimics, dorsal microchip voids, and pre-CSF herniation checks.

episodes.label: The Alarm Beyond the Wall — Post-Storm Portable Generator Exhaust Aerodynamics (167 Florida Cases, 16 Outdoor vs. 16 Garage), Wind-Wake Infiltration, Pulse Oximetry SpO2 Blindness & Battery CO Alarms
episodes.notes: Forensic investigation of post-storm portable generator carbon monoxide infiltration: 2004 Florida hurricane hospital/CPSC records (167 nonfatal cases in 51 incidents; 16 outdoor vs. 16 garage generators), aerodynamic wake infiltration through windows and window AC units, two-wavelength pulse oximetry SpO2 optical blindness vs. CO-oximetry, and North Carolina ice-storm battery-backed CO alarm survival evidence.

episodes.label: The Lunch That Looked Like an Allergy — Scombroid Histamine Fish Poisoning, Paris Yellowfin Tuna Outbreak (40 Cases, 39/79 Attack Rate), Heat-Stable Histidine Decarboxylation & Supply-Chain Forensics
episodes.notes: Outbreak epidemiology and food toxicology of scombroid histamine fish poisoning: Velut et al.'s (2019) Paris military-canteen yellowfin tuna outbreak (40 cases, 39/79 tuna diners vs. 31-case/63-control questionnaire), bacterial histidine decarboxylation into heat-stable histamine mimicking IgE anaphylaxis, CDC 2006 Louisiana/Tennessee tuna traceback contrasts, and FDA CPG 540.525 surveillance rules.

episodes.label: The Staircase in the Scan — Postmortem CT, Photogrammetry & VR Stair-Fall Reconstruction (31/35 cm Injury Spacing vs. 32 cm Tread Depth), CPR Rib-Fracture CT vs. Autopsy Discordance & Ontario Fatal Stair Falls
episodes.notes: Forensic radiology and 3D spatial reconstruction of fatal stair falls: Fukuda et al.'s (2025) alignment of postmortem CT skeletal meshes, autopsy surface-injury photogrammetry (31 cm and 35 cm inter-injury intervals), and scene stair tread depth (32 cm); Hamanaka et al.'s (2020) paired comparison of CT vs. autopsy detection of complete vs. buckle rib fractures after CPR; and Legaspi et al.'s (2023) 159 confirmed Ontario fatal stair falls.

episodes.label: The Alcohol That Arrived Late — Postmortem Microbial Neo-Formation of Ethanol, Higher Alcohol Congeners (n-Propanol), Vitreous Humor & Urine EtG/EtS Biomarkers vs. Antemortem Ingestion
episodes.notes: Separating antemortem alcohol consumption from postmortem microbial fermentation: how bacteria and fungi generate ethanol alongside higher-alcohol congeners (1-propanol, isobutanol, isoamyl alcohol) in decomposing blood, multi-site comparison with vitreous humor and urine, and non-oxidative ethanol conjugates (ethyl glucuronide and ethyl sulfate).

episodes.label: The Pollen in the Tread — Forensic Palynology in a Vineyard Homicide (441 Pinus Grains in Tire Track vs. Local Pollen Rain), Footwear Transfer Persistence & Similarity Index Limits
episodes.notes: Forensic palynology from crime-scene tire tracks to controlled transfer experiments: interpreting localized pine-pollen anomalies against wind-borne pollen rain in a vineyard homicide (Ozmen & Baysal 2026), footwear pollen pickup and secondary persistence dynamics (Serrudo Gonzales et al. 2024), and the statistical limits of assemblage similarity scores.

episodes.label: The Clock Inside the Chest — Postmortem Pacemaker & ICD Interrogation, Cloud Telemetry Timestamps (Straw 2024) & Blinded Forensic Device Audits (Lackermair 2022)
episodes.notes: Forensic electrophysiology of postmortem cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) interrogation: remote cloud telemetry alerts preceding body discovery (2024 Connected to the Cloud case), Lackermair et al.'s (2022) blinded forensic autopsy interrogation series, intracardiac electrogram differentiation of tachyarrhythmic vs. non-arrhythmic death, and clock-drift/electromechanical dissociation pitfalls.

episodes.label: The Tooth on Both Sides of the Curve — Bomb-Pulse 14C Enamel Dating, Two-Tooth Developmental Ordering, Bone vs. Hair Turnover Clocks & Cold-Case Identification
episodes.notes: Forensic bomb-pulse radiocarbon (14C) dating and multi-tissue chronology: resolving rising vs. falling bomb-pulse curve intersections using two developing teeth in Speller et al. (2012), enamel AMS preparation and developmental offsets (Buchholz & Spalding 2010), dental collagen vs. vertebral bone turnover vs. hair shaft growth clocks (Bertrand et al. 2024), and the 9-case verified crown-date validation subset (Teglind et al. 2021).

episodes.label: The Tree That Stayed in the Timber — Forensic Timber STR & Chloroplast Profiling, Koompassia Log-to-Stump Matching, Shorea Databases & UNODC Likelihood Ratios
episodes.notes: Forensic botany and timber DNA identification: matching three seized Koompassia malaccensis logs (L75, L79, L80) to stump S12 across a 1,465-tree Malaysian reference database (Lee et al. 2025), Shorea leprosula population (45.9%) vs. regional (88.7%) self-assignment across 1,410 trees (Ng et al. 2022), chloroplast vs. nuclear STR inheritance (Ng et al. 2017), Eucalyptus DNA and dendrochronological exclusion (Roman et al. 2020), and UNODC (2016) likelihood-ratio principles.

episodes.label: The Calabar Bean & the Missing Signal — Physostigmine, Acetylcholinesterase Ser203 Carbamylation, Antimuscarinic Delirium & QRS Counterfactuals
episodes.notes: From Efik esere ordeal records in Old Calabar and Thomas Richard Fraser's Edinburgh experiments to human acetylcholinesterase Ser203 carbamylation (4EY4/1GQR), false-positive urine TCA immunoassays, and ECG QRS gating in antimuscarinic delirium.

episodes.label: The Level That Rose After the Last Pill — Delayed Enteric & Modified-Release Absorption, Pharmacobezoars, Auto-Inhibition & Rising Post-Admission Drug Levels
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology investigation of rising post-ingestion drug concentrations in hospitalized patients: modified-release formulation kinetics, pyloric spasm and ileus, pharmacobezoar formation, and why a single triage drug level misses late peak toxicity.

episodes.label: The Muscle That Waited — Prolonged Post-Succinylcholine Neuromuscular Blockade, Zero Train-of-Four Twitches, Dibucaine Number 41 vs. Catalytic BChE Activity & BCHE Genotyping
episodes.notes: Pharmacogenetics and clinical management of prolonged succinylcholine apnea (Hubbell et al. 2025): why a short-acting depolarizing neuromuscular blocker lasted 8 hours after hip surgery, peripheral nerve stimulator absence of twitches, distinguishing quantitative butyrylcholinesterase deficiency from qualitative atypical variants via the dibucaine inhibition number, and BCHE sequencing.

episodes.label: The Blood That Would Not Turn Red — Acquired Methemoglobinemia (SpO2 86% vs. PaO2 85 mmHg), Multi-Wavelength Co-Oximetry, NADPH Reductase & G6PD Methylene Blue Hemolysis
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology deep dive into acquired methemoglobinemia and antidote mechanics: why dual-wavelength pulse oximetry locks near 85–86% despite high dissolved arterial PaO2, multi-wavelength co-oximetry separation of ferric (Fe3+) methemoglobin, how methylene blue uses NADPH methemoglobin reductase as an artificial electron shuttle, and why G6PD deficiency converts methylene blue into a trigger for acute Heinz-body hemolysis (Mathiyalagan et al. 2025; ProvayBlue US label).

episodes.label: The Signal the Poison Interrupted — Delayed Belladonna Atropine Rebound via LC-MS/MS, Scopolamine Hippocampal Theta Disruption & Physostigmine vs. Lorazepam in Antimuscarinic Delirium
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology investigation of central and peripheral muscarinic blockade: delayed gastrointestinal absorption and day-4 LC-MS/MS serum atropine rebound after belladonna ingestion (Hayashi et al. 2026), human intracranial EEG evidence of scopolamine disrupting hippocampal theta oscillations during memory encoding (Gedankien et al. 2023), and randomized trial evidence comparing physostigmine cholinesterase inhibition against lorazepam sedation in antimuscarinic delirium.

episodes.label: The Cocaine Signal That Stayed Behind — Cocaine-Associated Chest Pain, Serial hs-cTnI Trajectory, Human DAT-Cocaine Cryo-EM (PDB 9EO4), Benzoylecgonine/Cocaethylene LC-MS/MS & Lange Vasospasm
episodes.notes: Behind the Curtain Pharmacology & Forensic Toxicology of cocaine: why urine immunoassays detect hydrolytic metabolite benzoylecgonine for days after parent cocaine (T1/2 ~1h) has cleared, Nielsen et al.'s (2024) 2.66 Å cryo-EM structure of human DAT bound to cocaine (PDB 9EO4), hepatic carboxylesterase transesterification with ethanol to form long-acting cocaethylene, serial hs-cTnI rule-in, and Lange et al.'s (1989, 1990) coronary catheterization proof of alpha-adrenergic vasospasm.

sections.heading: Autopsy Biomechanics, High-Speed Impact Physics & Environmental Traps

episodes.label: The Residue on the Far Side — Gunshot Propellant Grains Near an Exit Wound, Ballistic Composite Wound-Channel Transport, Secondary Transfer & SEM-EDS
episodes.notes: Forensic ballistics and gunshot residue (GSR) interpretation traps: Weber et al.'s (2023) case observation of suspected unburned propellant grains at an established exit wound, Grosse Perdekamp et al.'s (2011) skin-gelatin-bone composite transport models, French et al.'s (2014) secondary GSR transfer experiments, and Askar et al.'s (2025) SEM-EDS elemental particle classification.

episodes.label: The Trail That Changed the Case — Outdoor Blood-Trail & CCTV Miscarriage Review, Laber Context Bias, Hicklin BPA Error Rates & Droplet Fluid Dynamics
episodes.notes: Forensic bloodstain pattern analysis (BPA) and evidentiary boundaries: Grey et al.'s (2022) London miscarriage-of-justice case review integrating an outdoor drip trail, arterial injury anatomy, and CCTV timing; Laber et al.'s (2014) NIJ context-bias experiments; Laan et al.'s (2015) droplet impact fluid dynamics; and Hicklin et al.'s (2021) black-box accuracy and reproducibility study.

sections.heading: Postmortem Drug Redistribution, Poisonings, Archaeotoxicology & Forensic Ledgers

episodes.label: The Metal the Hair Remembered — Familial Thallium Poisoning Blood/Urine vs. Postmortem Hair & Single-Strand LA-ICP-MS Longitudinal Profiling
episodes.notes: Forensic toxicology of thallium across biological matrices: Di Candia et al.'s (2020) family poisoning investigation contrasting antemortem blood/urine clearance with postmortem keratin incorporation, Luo et al.'s (2017) single-hair laser ablation ICP-MS validation, and Matsukawa & Heitland longitudinal profiling limits.

episodes.label: How Everyday Sleep Aids, Caffeine Rebound and Nitrous Turn Lethal
Meth Gut Infarction, Rubbing Alcohol Lies and Synthetic Hallucinogens
Solving an Invisible Succinylcholine ICU Homicide
Why Postmortem Drug Redistribution Deceives Autopsies
Wild Garlic Mistakes and Lethal Colchicine Mitotic Arrest
Cherry Red Cyanide Blood Versus Sodium Nitrite Hypoxia
How Licorice Tea Caused Sudden Paralysis

How Amphetamines Killed Tom Simpson

Green and Blue Autopsy Organs, Smoked Pills and Anesthetic Traps
Umbrella Methylmercury, Shaken Baby Mimics and Broken Forensic Rules
What the Hair Could Tell Us — Early Iron Age Tunnug 1 Cannabis Burial, Hair-Shaft CBN LC-HRMS/MS vs. Environmental Transfer, Human CB1-Gi1 Cryo-EM (PDB 9ERX) & Hallstatt Radiocarbon
episodes.notes: Archaeotoxicology and receptor pharmacology of ancient cannabis at Tunnug 1 (Tuva, Early Iron Age): LC-HRMS/MS detection of cannabinol (CBN) in a preserved human hair braid alongside 965 botanical cannabis seeds, Hallstatt Plateau 14C calibration, human CB1-Gi1 cryo-EM structure (PDB 9ERX), forensic hair-testing boundaries between smoke/handling transfer and metabolic THC-COOH incorporation (Moosmann et al. 2015), and comparative Eurasian archaeobotany.

episodes.label: The Feast in the Ground — Durrington Walls Near Stonehenge (~2500 BCE), Roasted Pig Bones vs. Dairy/Beef Grooved-Ware Lipids, Multi-Isotope Livestock Mobility & Coprolite Parasites
episodes.notes: Multi-proxy archaeological forensics at Durrington Walls (~2500 BCE): resolving the pig-bone vs. cattle/dairy potsherd lipid paradox through culinary segregation (Craig et al. 2015), five-isotope British livestock provenance (Madgwick et al. 2019), and Mitchell's coprolite paleoparasitology showing poorly cooked bovine/canid-shared tapeworm and capillariid infections.

episodes.label: The Last Meal in the Bog — Tollund Man's Gut Contents, Barley-Flax-Weed Gruel, Whipworm Eggs & Forensic Reconstruction
episodes.notes: Multi-proxy forensic re-analysis of Tollund Man's large-intestinal contents (Nielsen et al. 2021): plant macrofossils, pollen, non-pollen palynomorphs, ancient DNA, proteins, lipids, Trichuris trichiura eggs, and why threshing waste was intentionally added.

episodes.label: The Reference Sample Had Changed — Post-Transplant Forensic DNA Chimerism Across Blood (100% Donor), Buccal Swabs (Mixed Leukocyte Infiltration) & Hair/Eyebrow Follicles
episodes.notes: Forensic genetics of biological chimerism after allogeneic hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation: why blood reference samples convert completely to the donor's STR and amelogenin sex profile, why buccal swabs yield variable donor-recipient DNA mixtures due to mucosal leukocyte trafficking, and why hair shafts and eyebrow follicles remain reliable recipient reference tissues (Jacewicz et al. 2013; Li et al. 2014; 2026 eyebrow follicle study).

episodes.label: Nasopharyngeal Thresholds, Placentomes, and Polybasic Cleavage — Human Respiratory Pathogen NAAT, IS481 Pseudo-Outbreaks & FluPOC (H023), Livestock Pregnancy Ultrasound & Sexing (V045), Swine PRRS Processing Fluids (V047) & Poultry HPAI Furin Cleavage (V048)
episodes.notes: One Medicine Comparative Respiratory Virology, Theriogenology & Biosecurity synthesis of human respiratory NAAT (H023), livestock pregnancy ultrasound (V045), swine PRRS (V047), and poultry avian influenza (V048): ICU lower-tract & adult RSV multispecimen yields, Ct/viability kinetics, the 2006 IS481 pertussis pseudo-outbreak, FluPOC (n=613), and Hamburg forensic autopsies (n=80); bovine fetal sexing & goat hydrometra; PRRS processing fluids & tonsillar persistence; and HPAI polybasic cleavage, BHI swab chemistry, and duck AGID blindness.

episodes.label: The Lactate That Wasn't There — Ethylene Glycol Poisoning, Point-of-Care Glycolate Oxidase Cross-Reactivity & True Lab Lactate
